scan_linter_check.description:
Flags filtered query() calls on a GlideRecord whose rows are read only once (next() is called once and never as a loop condition) and that have no setLimit() or chooseWindow(). The database still prepares every matching row. Unfiltered queries are reported by SN-GR-001 instead. Server-side scripts only.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Missing setLimit on Single-Record Queries".
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-005: Single-record read without setLimit(1)
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Add setLimit(1) before query() when only one record is read, or use get() for a lookup by a unique field.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A filtered query reads only one record but has no setLimit(1).
